# Architecture decision record — <decision title>

Status: Proposed | Accepted | Superseded
Date: YYYY-MM-DD

## Decision
State the decision in one sentence.

## Context
List the product and operational requirements that drive the choice.

## Options
Compare at least two realistic options, including the current course stack where relevant.

## Criteria
Use explicit criteria: integration effort, type consistency, security boundary, deployment cost, course maintenance and fit for one developer.

## Trade-offs
Record a simple decision matrix and the material disadvantages of each option.

## Final Choice
Explain why the selected option fits this product and its constraints.

## Consequences
Record implementation tasks, known risks and a condition that would trigger revisiting the decision.
